title: Average Collector Box
text:
First of all, this is just an average collector box... The two POP! figures look like standard issue figurines. The T-shirt is rather colorful with the main heroes on it. The pin seems to be well made. The sticker is just okay.

I purchased three new boxes when this was at a discount. One box came sealed with all the five items while two boxes were open (one with missing shirt and pin and the other with none of the original contents).

Funko should do better when curating these collector boxes with more impressive POP! figures and unique T-shirts. Perhaps they'll take note and come up with greater ideas in the future.
label: neutral
